entities.text: Noida Thru Chairman-Cum-Chief ... vs Kude And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1.  The instant first appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act has been filed by New Okhla Industrial Development Authority (Noida), Gautam Budh Nagar (hereinafter referred to as the 'Authority') challenging the award and decree dated 24.05.2002 passed by the 11th Additional District Judge, Ghaziabad in L.A.R.No.298 of 1996 (Kude and others vs. State of U.P. and others),
whereby for the land acquired in village Hajratpur Vajidpur, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar, a compensation @ Rs.153/- per square yard has been awarded along with other consequential benefit as admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
2.

entities.text: Kude and others vs. State of U.P. and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Sri Shivam Yadav, learned counsel for the appellant-Authority submitted that regarding similarly acquired land, the land owners have already been awarded enhanced compensation @ Rs.203/- per square yard in First Appeal No.1183 of 2004 (Rohtash Singh and others vs. State of U.P. and another) connected with 19 other appeals, which has not been challenged by the Authority before the Apex Court, as such, the appeal be also decided in terms of the order dated 19.05.2015 passed by this Court in the above mentioned appeals.

entities.text: Rohtash Singh and others vs. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Heard Sri Shivam Yadav, learned counsel for the appellant.
None is present for the respondents.

4. In the instant appeal, the matter relates to land acquired in village Hajratpur Vajidpur, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar, regarding which notification under Section 4(1) of the Act was issued on 15.02.1992, wherein the Collector made an award on 13.05.1996, awarding compensation @ Rs.60/- per square yard, which was enhanced by the Reference Court, vide impugned award and decree dated 24.05.2002 to Rs.153/- per square yard,
which has been further enhanced by this Court, vide order dated 19.05.2015 passed in First Appeal No.1183 of 2004 (Rohtash Singh and others vs. State of U.P. and another) connected with 19 other appeals, wherein the compensation has been enhanced to Rs.203/- per square yard along with other statutory benefits as available under the Land Acquisition Act, 1984, which has not been challenged by the Authority before the Apex Court, as such, the order dated 19.05.2015, passed by this Court, in above mentioned appeals has attained finality, and accordingly, the compensation awarded by the Reference Court @ Rs.153/- per square yard cannot be reduced.
5.

entities.text: Rohtash Singh and others vs. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the above facts, the instant appeal filed by the Authority, for reducing the compensation awarded by the Reference Court from Rs.153/- per square yard is meritless and is accordingly,
dismissed.
6.
However, in the facts and circumstances of the case, the parties shall bear their respective costs.
7. Office is directed to prepare the decree, accordingly.
(Sandeep Jain,J.) September 26, 2025 Mayank  Noida Thru Chairman-Cum-Chief ... vs Kude And Others on 26 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137124236/
